notes: Sepolia (chain 11155111), second test run of the mainnet candidate. Deploy all six contracts in the listed dependency order, with zero ETH, in one factory transaction. Same code as the mainnet branch plus the full Intake v2 failure function (explicit checks and the PleaFailed event). Changes from launch #1242: a PLEA season bonus (PLEA.init mints 88% to the hook, 2% to Seasons, 10% to the distributor; each of the first four seasons pays 5,000,000 PLEA to its qualifying top 10 with the IMD prize shares and burns the unpaid rest; flushToWall burns what is left after the Cabal dies; no withdrawal path), the cap decays to its floor in 25 days (capDecayPerDay set at seed), a POOL4-style wall placement guard, and Intake v2 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82: pleas ask with requestWithFailure; onPleaFailure clears only our own still-pending plea and never moves value; expire() after 20 minutes stays as the fallback. Oracle fee asset 0x44a1... (test IMD, open mint), pool IMD TestIMD 0x2B69..., Stacker 0x293C... (imd/acc launch #1129), oracle signer 0x5598...2982. 18000-second seasons (fast test clock), 118800-second dead-man, START 1792162800 (Fri 2026-10-16 15:00 UTC; the owner may seed earlier), credit gas 1300000 (Sepolia's gas schedule: a first Stacker credit costs ~698k). Fees, plea timings, panel 30 and quorum 17 are unchanged. PleaHook is not a manifest entry: PleaLaunch commits to its init-code hash and deployHook(salt, initCode) deploys it with a salt mined for the hook flags; seed() opens trading.
